## Parental OpControl 0.17.4

- Fixed the lock screen title showing a second, misaligned copy behind it. The title was drawn twice: once by a WinForms label (which could not use the embedded fonts) and once as a manual shadow. Every line is now drawn once, with a real blurred, low-opacity shadow offset 3 px down.
- The lock screen now uses the bundled Fredoka and Nunito fonts at the intended weights (Fredoka 600 title and primary button, Fredoka 500 reason, Nunito 700 hint, Nunito 800 override). The variable fonts were pinned to static faces because GDI+ cannot select a weight from a variable font; the family is checked and logged once at runtime.
- The title, reason, hint and both buttons are each centred horizontally on the screen, measured line by line. The reason and hint no longer sit against the title's left edge.
- The vertical rhythm now matches the approved reference: 18 px title→reason, 10 px reason→hint, 40 px hint→button, 16 px between buttons, 72 px and 52 px pills, with the whole block centred slightly above the middle. All sizes scale with the screen and DPI.
- Verified with the real overlay renderer at 100%, 125%, 150% and 200% at 1600x900, 1620x1080 and 1366x768 in English and es-MX. A layout test asserts every line and button centre is within 1 px of the screen centre and that no elements overlap; the Spanish title wraps instead of overflowing.
- No data, account, PIN, family or Windows setting changes. Luna stays enabled with the same key. This release is installed on the X1 only; the Yoga is not updated.
